issues.title: Fresh native runtime P2 command probe is blocked
issues.detail: The simulator contract and a read-only pre-existing window prove the expected P1/P2 shape, but two fresh approved-launcher attempts were rejected while protected SC2 leases owned port 5151 and then port 5152.
issues.nextAction: After all protected leases are released by their owners, rerun the approved launcher and verify P1 ActionChat, P2 Galaxy order, RequestStep state delta, and same-window ScriptError absence.
